# Phase 4 tasks — the YouTube source

Each task is sized for one cheap-worker run (≤ ~10 files, ≤ ~400 lines of diff; see `AGENT_WORKFLOW.md`). The full spec for each lives in `docs/build/tasks/<id>.md` and is committed on `main` before its worker starts. External facts (the InnerTube `search` request shape, yt-dlp's error strings, the bgutil provider) were verified by the researcher agent on 2026-10-05 (P4-00, below, and `docs/research/research_youtube.md` §1–2); recorded responses live under `tests/fixtures/ytmusic/` and `tests/fixtures/ytdlp/`.

Gate (`PHASES.md` Phase 4): songs missing on Soulseek are filled from Art Tracks within one search cycle and pass fingerprint verification; official-video candidates with intros are rejected by duration; a simulated bot-check response backs off instead of looping.

## Design decisions taken for Phase 4 (recorded in `docs/DECISIONS.md`, Build session 5)

- **No YoutubeDLSharp.** The researcher verified (2026-10-05) its option set was last synced to yt-dlp ~3 years ago and the repo moves slowly; the wrapper's API drift is a liability against a tool that ships emergency releases monthly. Wondarr shells out to yt-dlp directly through the existing `IProcessRunner` (the same pattern as ffprobe/fpcalc), with `--print after_move:filepath` for the output path and `-J`-style JSON for metadata — the yt-dlp README's own recommended integration surface. Amends the STACK.md row (YoutubeDLSharp → direct subprocess).
- **The InnerTube client is ours, minimal, and keyless.** ytmusicapi's current source (verified 2026-10-05) sends **no API key at all** for unauthenticated search — the key is only appended for cookie-authenticated calls. Wondarr's client sends the same request shape: `POST https://music.youtube.com/youtubei/v1/search?alt=json` with the WEB_REMIX context (`clientVersion` computed as `"1." + YYYYMMDD + ".01.00"`), the `songs`/`videos` `params` constants, the Firefox User-Agent, `origin: https://music.youtube.com`, and the `SOCS=CAI` cookie. No key to rotate, no scraping of the homepage (the `X-Goog-Visitor-Id` ytmusicapi scrapes is not required for search).
- **Search order** (MATCHING_ENGINE §6.4): ISRC query first (when the song has ISRCs), then `songs` filter on "main artists - title", then `videos` only when the source rule allows it (default off — the `videos` filter is where OMVs with intros and UGC uploads live). A verified (ATV) candidate scoring ≥ 850 ends the search immediately.
- **The duration gate is the intro defence.** An OMV (official music video) runs longer than the recording it is "of" — the classic hazard is Oasis "Wonderwall": song 4:19, video 4:38 (the research's own example). The decision engine's existing duration tolerance (profile default 3 s) already rejects such candidates; Phase 4 pins it with golden cases (ATV within tolerance, OMV +19 s rejected) so the gate item is demonstrated by a test, not by hoping.
- **A bot check backs off, never loops.** The taxonomy classifies yt-dlp's stderr (`"Sign in to confirm you're not a bot"`, `"This content isn't available, try again later"`, HTTP 429/402, geo, age gate, private/unavailable) into: *retry-later* (bot check, rate limit — the item is failed with the reason, the song's backoff applies, never an immediate retry) and *blocklist* (geo, private, unavailable — that video is never tried again for the song). The gate's simulated bot check asserts the second attempt waits, not loops.
- **The output policy is per library, and the quality is the source's.** Defaults AAC-256 `.m4a` (owner round 2 #3); "keep Opus" writes the lossless remux `.opus`; MP3 selectable. Whatever the container, a YouTube file's `quality_id` is `OPUS-160` (id 28) — the quality of what YouTube served — so a 320 cutoff keeps it upgradeable (ADR-0008). "Lossless from lossy" is refused: the transcode step never writes FLAC/ALAC from a YouTube source, and `.webm` never lands in the library (ADR-0006).
- **YouTube is off by default with a one-time disclaimer** (the research's legal section): enabling it in Settings shows the ToS warning once; no cookies or accounts are bundled; the bgutil PO-token sidecar is the user's own, pointed at through `youtube.po_token_base_url`.

## What the workers must not do

- Never write `.webm` into the library or the download folder's final name; the remux to `.opus` happens in yt-dlp's post-processor (`-x --audio-format opus`), and the runner asserts the final extension.
- Never produce a lossless container from a lossy source (ADR-0006/0008).
- Never exceed YouTube's tolerance: concurrency 1, `--sleep-requests 0.75`, `--sleep-interval 10 --max-sleep-interval 20`, no live calls in tests or CI (recorded fixtures only; live is opt-in on `ch01`).
- Never touch `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/DECISIONS.md`, `docs/adr/`, `.claude/`, `.github/workflows/`, `.env*`.
